payload.core_mechanism_summary: Starts with all '?' assigned to the cheaper character, computes initial cost using prefix/suffix counts. For each '?', swaps its assignment if exchanging reduces total cost, updating counts dynamically.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly uses a greedy exchange argument: initial assignment minimizes cost based on comparing x and y, then iteratively flips each '?' and recalculates cost using precomputed left/right counts, typical for this subtype.
